title: HB 133 (111th General Assembly): As introduced, authorizes the use of a driver license from another state to establish a person's identity for the purposes of being issued a photo identification license by the department of safety for the purposes of voting. - Amends TCA Title 2 and Title 55, Chapter 50.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id) not stated.
(b_no_id_remedy)
(section) 55-50-336(g)(1)(A) (Sec. 1)
(quote) (A) Does not have a valid government-issued photo identification necessary for voting in this state;
(section) 55-50-336(g)(2) (Sec. 2)
(quote) even if the person has a valid nonphoto bearing driver license or a valid driver license from another state
(section) 55-50-336(g)(3) new (Sec. 3)
(quote) (3) A person applying for a photo identification license under this subsection (g) may establish the person's identity with a valid driver license from another state.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule) not stated.
(other) Sec. 4: takes effect on becoming law.
(other) version: 1870176-Draft: Draft only; carries slot b text (free voting photo ID under 55-50-336(g): applicant may prove identity with another state's driver license; rewrites (g)(1)(A) and adds to (g)(2)).
(other) note: Only the Draft is saved. The existing wording of 55-50-336(g)(1)(A) and (g)(2) is not in the file, so what changed in (g)(1)(A) cannot be stated beyond the replacement text. Companion pair HB133/SB90 have identical text. Bill dies in committee (deferred/taken off notice or sent to subcommittee); no roll call saved.
